s00034.summary: Captain Holloway gathers his crew and announces they sail Thursday
Adebayo and Finch question the cargo and Vane's insurance
Jeremiah asks about the cargo; Holloway evasively says tea
Adebayo hints at the true cargo and Lisbon until Holloway silences them
Jeremiah offers to keep quiet, which troubles Mrs. Finch

s01553.summary: Coach hammers Jazz about being fourteen down at halftime
Coach slams the clipboard and they argue about watching the ball
Rookie Dee bursts in asking to speak
Dee reveals the opponents' shoulder tell and the team resolves to hit it

s01185.summary: Sadie walks the drive-in to meet a stranger on a pickup
Big Tommy rises with a tire iron as the stranger's insurance
Detective Ortega steps out with a gun ordering hands up
Tommy swings, popcorn flies, Ortega fires, and everyone dives
The stranger gives a name, retracts it, and the truck roars alive

s01593.summary: Teddy studies a ledger in the hushed archive reading room
Teddy finds something on a page and catches Ezekiel watching
Teddy photographs the page as Miriam notices
Ezekiel strolls over and probes Teddy politely about the ledger
Miriam reveals the ledger has been requested four times this year
Teddy returns the ledger and leaves
Ezekiel requests the same ledger and photographs the marked page

s02421.summary: The derby team gears up as Coach outlines the semifinal stakes
Wanda jokes about skating the rival into the wall
Gus checks name pronunciations until Coach throws him out
Wanda assigns rookie Delphine to jam, and she admits fear
Sunny and Coach steady Delphine with the game plan
At the whistle the team puts hands in and Delphine leads the call

s00320.summary: Odalys sits in the lighthouse tea shop as Bram serves tea
Odalys lays out the suspicious fire in a sealed cellar
Bram deflects with charm about keys and accusations
Hester speaks up that Bram didn't light it and mentions the logbook
Hester reveals the logbook survives and the drowned boy kept in the cellar
Bram shatters the teapot and shouts that no one should have opened the door

s01937.summary: Late at night Theodore finds Bernadette sitting in the MRI suite
Bernadette questions why he is there if her scan is clean
Bernadette accuses him of lying at her daughter's request
Theodore gives her the folder and admits fourteen months to live
Bernadette accepts it gracefully and asks him to sit with her
They listen to the machine's hum together as the rain eases

s00256.summary: Kaspar questions a cool Olga about the man who wrote her
Kaspar tells Olga he was poisoned; she shrugs it off
Kaspar closes in and demands her left glove
Under the glove, a fingertip bruise proves the victim fought her
Olga breaks free and they grapple, she stabbing with a hairpin
Kaspar's wife interrupts and Olga laughs at the situation

s00146.summary: Beatrix notarizes papers at Henry's kitchen table
Henry insists he's ready to transfer the deed; Dante witnesses shakily
Henry notes his daughter Keiko is gone; it goes to her children
Henry names Dante trustee despite Dante's reluctance
Henry reads every line and signs; Beatrix stamps and pours coffee

s00626.summary: Stranded on the salt flat, Imogen and Callum ration the last water
Imogen ties a braided map strip around Callum's wrist
They silently push the last water back and forth
Imogen spots a drip; the full water tank and spare jug are empty

s00707.summary: In the laundry back room Vince counts cash in silence
Vince asks who locked up; Moe and Dolly's answers clash
Vince notices Nadia watching the door, and the front bell chimes

s00945.summary: In the empty NICU an answering machine records a silent call
Philomena arrives, replays the silent message, and checks the line
On rounds she finds a baby staring at her unblinking
The sixth incubator is empty and its patient missing
By the phone she finds a warm bracelet bearing her own name
Monitors flatline and every incubator is empty; a breath on the line

s01003.summary: Harlan leads Penny and Nola through the flooded crypt
Nola insists there were four of them and counts four again
Harlan mutters reassurances and Nola says it is listening
A wake approaches and Harlan orders a retreat to the stairs
The stairs are gone, Penny's name is carved, the lanterns die

s01606.summary: Faith's family and a drifter shelter in the sealed cellar
The drifter holds up a jar and notes the peaches are alive
Ephraim names himself and warns Walt about what he keeps
Something scrapes slowly behind the shelves

s01004.summary: Leopold and Winifred muse about a frequently returned Dostoevsky
Winifred finds a note in a returned paperback signed C
A stranger arrives looking for a note and reveals he is C
Agnes tumbles down the book chute and claims the note
Stern Muriel orders the lovers out by the door
Muriel questions the volunteers, then finds her own note in the Dostoevsky

s01253.summary: Dr. Mercedes pours tea for three siblings in the hospice lounge
Mercedes calls it a rally; Ramiro hopes it means improvement
Felix resists, but Mercedes explains the brightness is the last good thing
Ramiro asks how long; Mercedes says days
The siblings plan the garden, the dog and the radio for her
The siblings leave; Ramiro thanks her and Mercedes places a puzzle piece

s00564.summary: Roscoe and Phoebe sit alone on the bus as a freight train passes
Phoebe reveals Roscoe volunteered to stay with her, and he blushes
Phoebe invites Roscoe to count the train cars together
Phoebe leans her shoulder on his and they keep counting
They hold hands as the last car passes and linger

s01099_1.summary: Gideon nervously begins his appeal and is corrected on address

s01760.summary: Aurelio and Beatrix grab the same ranunculus and collide in petals
They bicker over whose flowers they were
Nonna calls about wedding roses and asks about the girl
Beatrix tucks a flower behind his ear while he's on the phone
Beatrix claims the peonies and lilies; he keeps the ranunculus
They discover they're supplying weddings at the same hour

s02026.summary: Renata checks a duffel of cash and passports in the stairwell
Elias climbs up armed and finds her; Hannah follows
Both lunge for the bag and fight brutally on the landing
Hannah raises her weapon shakily, ordering them to stop
A siren freezes them and Amara appears pleading innocence
They part and Renata sits and offers her wrists

s01515.summary: Imani runs a final check on the donor heart cooler at the helipad
Alaric asks if the cooler should feel so heavy and so light
Clearance comes and Imani heads for the helicopter
Seraphina looks over the city and thanks the donor aloud

s00462.summary: Nell watches the ballroom and trades glances with Captain Julian
Aunt Beatrice notes the captain has been staring; Nell feigns ignorance
Julian asks Nell to dance and, with Beatrice's nod, she accepts
They waltz, stiff then easy, as the room blurs gold
Drunken Lord Percival crashes in shouting Nell's name
Julian blocks Percival, who swings his bottle at stewards
Nell faces Percival and denies she promised him anything
Percival crumples and Beatrice leads him away
The waltz resumes and Nell takes Julian's hand again

s00674.summary: A voice on the intercom asks Hartwig about the Calloway disappearance
Cora cites the logbook in his hand and reveals she's on the landing
Cora enters and reveals Daniel Calloway was her brother
Cora produces Daniel's sub-basement key found in the river
Cora catches Hartwig knowing her name and exposes his lie
Hartwig shows the director's written confession to the murder
Pressed on why he waited, Hartwig admits his fear

s00688.summary: Yusuf meets Bea and their father at the empty diner
Yusuf demands why the diner is for sale and Bea erupts
Bea stops Yusuf leaving and Lenny pours coffee for them

s00926.summary: In the bunker the radio announces a ceasefire
Kofi asks if it's a trick; slowly they believe it
Command asks for acknowledgment; Isadora asks for a minute

s00258.summary: Hester needles Amara about writing in her book by the fire
Amara explains her trip to Redwater and asks to rent Hester's horse
Hester tells how her husband rode to Redwater and never returned
Hester tells the dark the horse will ride again
Amara invites Hester to come along and Hester finally laughs

s01271.summary: Lt. Farquhar climbs into the bell tower where her squad holds
Tanks advance and Farquhar orders Li to cover the glinting bell
A shell hits the nave as Li starts to panic
Basco fails to raise anyone while infantry approach
Counting magazines, Li notes the medic is dead
Shells close in; Halasz steadies terrified Li with dark humor
Basco finally reaches someone on the radio
A direct hit; the squad takes positions and Li asks Halasz not to let him stop
